accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:honest-spectral-band / ass:admissible-external-code
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The band is conditional on a deterministic, externally certified code satisfying the conditional direct-L1 radius; it makes no auxiliary-sample learning claim.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform honesty and width hold over law-code pairs under the stated external-code certificate, not over codes learned from the inference sample.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:minimax-all-band-width / ass:hard-subclass-compatibility
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The converse is conditional on the displayed primitive constants admitting a nonempty asymmetric exact-code Gaussian-regression subclass.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The all-band lower bound holds for fixed constants with nonempty hard-triple compatibility set.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 8, Theorem 5.4, conditions (21) and bound (22); p. 53, Lemma G.7
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 5.4 assumes independent sub-Gaussian treatment noise with a separated cumulant and gives a finite-order ACE error bound involving supplied nuisance radii; Lemma G.7 states its supplied treatment-regression error in unconditional L^s(P) form.

The preprint studies continuous-treatment causal functionals under unconfoundedness, derives uniform Bahadur representations, and develops bootstrap uniform confidence bands with minimum-variance balancing weights and data-driven bias control.
The article constructs a doubly robust uniform confidence band for a binary-treatment CATE function using propensity and outcome-regression nuisance models.
The paper derives maximum-deviation asymptotics and simultaneous confidence bands for classical varying-coefficient functions estimated by local-polynomial regression.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1303.7152, corroborating the cited Annals of Statistics article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops anti-concentration and Gaussian-multiplier-bootstrap machinery for honest confidence bands, conditional on an indexed empirical-process approximation rather than supplying the proposed contour-ratio linearization.
The paper gives an expected-length inequality for confidence intervals with uniform coverage over a family of distributions, furnishing the stated testing-to-width template.
The paper derives minimax CATE estimation rates in a Hölder-smooth model and presents a rate-optimal local-polynomial estimator; it is not an honest expected-sup-width band result.
The article develops honest confidence sets with expected-diameter control for Tikhonov-regularized ill-posed models, including NPIV and functional regressions.
